parameters.query: =SELECT at.*, aw.document_id, aw.document_type FROM approval_tokens at LEFT JOIN approval_workflows aw ON at.workflow_id = aw.id WHERE at.token = '{{ $query.token }}' AND at.expiry_date > NOW() AND at.used_at IS NULL

=SELECT aw.*, wl.level_number as next_level_number, wl.level_name as next_level_name, wl.role_id as next_role_id, wl.timeout_hours as next_timeout_hours FROM approval_workflows aw INNER JOIN approval_tokens at ON aw.id = at.workflow_id LEFT JOIN workflow_levels wl ON wl.document_type = aw.document_type AND wl.level_number = aw.current_step + 1 AND wl.is_required = TRUE WHERE at.token = '{{ $query.token }}'
